replication.target_description: Experiment 1 replication; cleanliness versus neutral word-scramble prime in Bucknell University student volunteers; one-tailed t-test on average of the six original moral vignettes.

n.sample_role: College-student participants in target analysis; 30 in each condition, t-test df 58.
n.location: HTML report #149 (unpaginated; supplied p.1), Number of Subjects and Detailed Description of Method/Results
